study_type: Held-out synthetic single-base outage study, not field validation
selection: Minimum pooled training timely count, ties lowest original base index
outage: One base and its drone unavailable for the entire simulated season
uncertainty: Pointwise season-bootstrap Monte Carlo intervals, conditional on training selection; not input, selection, model or field uncertainty
non_goals: No observed failure probabilities, field performance or detector accuracy
No relocation, spare aircraft, optimal real sites or equal-budget comparison
No changes to historical models, protocols, captures or plots
